en.description: Turn a photo into anime, manga, comic, cartoon, watercolor, clay, or 3D character art while the person, pet, or product stays recognisable. This AI photo restyler works as a photo-to-anime converter and AI cartoonizer you can steer: apply a style like a filter over your own picture, or add style samples to steer the palette, line weight, and shading. A selfie, portrait, pet photo, product shot, or travel picture becomes illustration-style art for social avatars, profile pictures, sticker sets, posters, merchandise, and content series, with one chosen look repeated across a whole batch.
en.summary: Turn a photo into anime, manga, comic, cartoon, watercolor, clay, or 3D character art while the subject stays recognisable, and repeat the same look across a whole set.
en.title: AI Photo Restyler: Photo to Anime, Cartoon and Comic Art

zh.description: 把一张照片转成漫画风、动漫风、卡通、水彩、手绘、黏土或 3D 角色画风，同时保住人物、宠物或商品的辨识度。这个 AI 照片转绘、照片转漫画工具从你自己的图出发，加一张画风参考图做风格迁移，配色、线条和上色方式都照着走，让自拍、人像、宠物照、商品图或旅行照变成二次元插画风作品，用在社交头像、朋友圈配图、表情包素材、海报和周边上，第一张满意之后整批照片都按同一画风出。
